July, 2024
Author: Pankaj Bhatia

Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 7581 of 2024

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Pankaj Gupta,Narendra Gupta

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
Despite service of notice, no one appeared on behalf of the complainant.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.550 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376,
494 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Shahabad, District Hardoi.
3. In terms of the FIR lodged as a missing person report, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was enticed away by the applicant.
The victim did not support the prosecution story in the statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C.
The tentative age of the victim is around 19

1 years as per the medical examination report and the victim is also pregnant.
4. It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that the applicant and the victim stayed together as husband and wife.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the two statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C. and also considering the tentative age of the victim as 19 years and the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 12.02.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Vedram be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
